parent: LloydsPharmacy (online doctor business; ownership not checked in this stage)
model: UK online pharmacy and doctor service (Shopify shop front plus a server-driven questionnaire engine) selling licensed and off-label prescription hair-loss medicines to men.

access.accountWall: No sign-in is needed for the questions or the recommendation. "Continue as a new patient" (…/clinic/hair-loss?guest) starts as a guest. After the recommendation, choosing a product, the pack size (Add to basket) and a finasteride safety screen, the last screen is "Please confirm the following to complete your consultation" (question 100467, "I confirm the above"). The walk stopped there and did not press it, so the exact sign-in point (expected straight after it) was not seen.
blockers: A "This service operates in the United Kingdom only" pop-up (closed with "Continue with UK service"); not bot protection.
The engine is server-driven: the full question set is not in the browser code, so branches were mapped by walking.
Some checklist options open explanation pop-ups or could not be clicked by the walker (Phaeochromocytoma onwards in the conditions list, two medicines options, the previous-treatment list).
access.coverageNote: Every question on the baseline path and every option one level deep was walked live, except the items marked unknown. Recommendation cards were captured for the baseline man. Options that end the questions early were confirmed, but how each changes the final offer (product removal) was not compared: that is stage 2.

questions.text: What causes hair loss?: Male pattern hair loss is caused by a combination of genetics and sensitivity to DHT (dihydrotestosterone) , a hormone made from testosterone. In people who are susceptible, DHT gradually causes affected hair follicles to shrink and shortens the hair growth phase. New hairs become finer and shorter and may eventually stop growing in some areas of the scalp. Treatments can help slow further hair loss and may support regrowth. Options include finasteride and minoxidil , which work in different ways.
questions.purpose: Education: what causes male pattern hair loss.

questions.text: How does finasteride work?: Finasteride reduces DHT by blocking an enzyme that converts testosterone into DHT. Lowering DHT can slow the shrinking of affected hair follicles. When taken consistently, finasteride can slow hair loss and may support regrowth in some men.

How does minoxidil work?: Minoxidil increases blood flow and nutrients to hair roots. Used regularly, it can help hair grow back thicker over time. It usually takes a few months to notice a difference. Some men use finasteride and minoxidil together. Complete your assessment to find out what's right for you.

questions.text: Steroids are thought to create male pattern hair loss by causing your body to produce higher levels of dihydrotestosterone (DHT). DHT acts on the hair follicles on your scalp, causing them to weaken over time. They eventually die and stop growing back, which results in baldness. Taking Finasteride or Propecia is unlikely to be helpful if you are still taking steroids. Steroids can also cause lots of other problems such as erectile dysfunction, infertility, heart and kidney problems as well as mood disorders.

questions.text: Finasteride and trying for a baby: Finasteride can affect sperm quality in some men, which may make it harder to conceive. This is uncommon and sperm quality usually improves after stopping treatment . Only small amounts of finasteride pass into semen. Harm to a baby through this exposure is considered very unlikely. As a precaution, we don't prescribe finasteride to men who are trying for a baby. If you are planning to try for a baby, we recommend stopping finasteride at least 3 months before trying to conceive.

questions.text: Living with Pets: You've told us that you live with pets. Some of our treatments contain topical minoxidil , which is toxic to all pets including cats and dogs . The main risk is accidental exposure, for example if a pet licks minoxidil from your fingers, hair, skin, clothing, or bedding after application. Oral tablets or capsules are less likely to pose a risk because the medication does not sit on your hair or skin in the same way. However, tablets or capsules are still harmful if a pet ingests them. By continuing, you confirm that you understand this risk and will take appropriate precautions to protect your pets.

questions.text: Your Safety: Important safety information for your treatment: Finasteride has been associated with causing: - Low mood, depression, and suicidal thoughts - Sexual side effects such as reduced sex drive, difficulty getting or maintaining an erection, and problems with ejaculation. - Changes in breast tissue , including lumps, pain, or nipple discharge. If you develop depression or suicidal thoughts, stop treatment and contact your doctor immediately. If you ever feel at risk of harming yourself or have seriously harmed yourself, call emergency services on 999 immediately.

recommendations.profile: Man, 32, temples and crown, gradual, no conditions, no medicines, no allergies, no previous treatment, no pets
recommendations.note: Clinician-branded screen (GP named with GMC number): "Your hair loss is consistent with male pattern hair loss. You're new to hair loss treatment. You're suitable for Finasteride tablets, Minoxidil tablets and Minoxidil spray. As you're new to hair loss treatment, we'd recommend starting with a licensed treatment, such as Finasteride tablets and Minoxidil spray." Two combination cards first, then "Other suitable treatments" (finasteride, minoxidil tablets, Sons spray, Propecia). Both combination cards were flagged out of stock in the data.

engineSummary: A server-side rules engine asks one question per screen and decides the next screen from each answer. Signs that suggest another cause (female, complete or patchy loss, sudden onset, body hair loss, alopecia, eGFR under 30, serious liver disease) end the questions at once with no recommendation. Safety answers add warning or acknowledgement screens and, by their wording, remove finasteride (trying for a baby, mood opt-out) or topicals (scalp changes). The result screen lists what you are "suitable for", recommends licensed treatment first for new patients, and leads with combination packs.
strengths: Free, anonymous route to a named-clinician recommendation with prices before any account.
Clear safety screens (mood, crisis signposting, pets, trying for a baby).
Expectation-setting for temple-only and extensive loss.
weaknesses: Men only: women are stopped after two questions with no signposting seen in this stage.
Early stops give no explanation or alternative product before the consent screen (as seen so far).
Combination packs led the result while flagged out of stock.
opportunities: Explain early stops and signpost (e.g. alopecia areata, sudden loss) instead of ending silently.
limitations: FAQ and help-centre pages on eligibility, side effects and subscription terms were not read in this stage (time).
Product legal status for the minoxidil sprays is inferred.
The previous-treatment branch (108015) and its follow-ups, and four conditions-list options, were not mapped.
What the final screen shows after an early stop was only seen for the female route.
